classification: architect acceptance specification; not executed test or game evidence
author: gpt-6

cases.inputOrMutation: existing 63 blueprints without discriminator
cases.requiredResult: legacy dossier/wiki/map artifacts content-identical; no v3 fields

cases.inputOrMutation: explicit alternative-fulfillment-v3 and valid complete profile
cases.requiredResult: deterministic derived views retain the validated exact plan

cases.inputOrMutation: unknown discriminator, missing profile or schemaVersion other than 3
cases.requiredResult: reject with episode-local diagnostic; no legacy fallback

cases.inputOrMutation: unknown field or malformed v3 profile
cases.requiredResult: reuse schema failure; no silently stripped fields

cases.inputOrMutation: unknown identity, shared worker across services or generated original input
cases.requiredResult: existing semantic diagnostics preserved

cases.inputOrMutation: explicit point-to-zone and recipe presentation bindings
cases.requiredResult: all declared identities/costs/zones preserved without campaign literals

cases.inputOrMutation: missing/duplicate point or cross-service output/recipient binding
cases.requiredResult: reject binding, identify exact offending ID

cases.inputOrMutation: alter a derived world/objective/state/secondary/service view
cases.requiredResult: reject mismatch with single authoritative reference profile

cases.inputOrMutation: two services with unequal alternative costs
cases.requiredResult: one recipe per service; never create all-recipe fixed-payment predicates

cases.inputOrMutation: add shared resource-transaction or nonzero predicate.resourceAmounts
cases.requiredResult: reject explicit first-mapper limitation, without altering schema

cases.inputOrMutation: negative/fractional/boolean/nonfinite/unsafe amount or aggregate overflow
cases.requiredResult: reject before enumeration/account comparison

cases.inputOrMutation: no affordable complete selection in one difficulty despite possible optional aid
cases.requiredResult: reject that difficulty; aid cannot satisfy all-skip obligation

cases.inputOrMutation: choice affordable only by spending protected or optional reserve
cases.requiredResult: choice remains unaffordable; accounts stay distinct

cases.inputOrMutation: add reallocatedCacheAllowance to optional/spendable stock or mismatch optionalReserve
cases.requiredResult: reject inconsistent funding; no duplicate optional source

cases.inputOrMutation: 8x8 bounds, 4096 boundary and oversized product
cases.requiredResult: reuse v3 supported bounds; reject oversized structures

cases.inputOrMutation: artificial 3-service plan with different recipe counts/costs
cases.requiredResult: generic projection works without Constantinople constants

cases.inputOrMutation: explicit 2-service artificial regression based on dated allocation study
cases.requiredResult: 9/7/3 all-skip counts; counts labelled accounting only

cases.inputOrMutation: hard shared-hearth/rented leaves20W; repair costs50W; aid grants50W
cases.requiredResult: repair-first unavailable; aid-then-repair affordable; use existing accounting helper

cases.inputOrMutation: work/reception zones on distinct hubs overlap in absolute tile coordinates
cases.requiredResult: reject overlap despite distinct hub IDs

cases.inputOrMutation: zone centre inside map but full circle crosses edge
cases.requiredResult: reject full-footprint violation; no pathfinding claim

cases.inputOrMutation: shared objective latched while plan only reserved or incomplete
cases.requiredResult: no service-complete/victory presentation; genuine reducer gate retains selected work

cases.inputOrMutation: wrong-recipe output or generic fact substituted for selected generated identity
cases.requiredResult: genuine reference reducer rejects causal substitution

cases.inputOrMutation: selected receipts present but required recipient dead or absent in latest batch
cases.requiredResult: genuine reducer prevents victory and applies known-loss priority

cases.inputOrMutation: seven explicit authored optional contracts with three portfolios
cases.requiredResult: exact predicates/effects/funding/state and IDs retained; no regeneration by kind

cases.inputOrMutation: unbound service/recipe ID or reservation text claiming work complete
cases.requiredResult: reject binding; distinguish preview/reserve/cancel/start/reception

cases.inputOrMutation: long EN/es-ES screen supplied to existing caption helper
cases.requiredResult: same complete text, chunks at most32words; native/audio status stays pending

cases.inputOrMutation: Bun unavailable, malformed JSON or nonzero validation subprocess
cases.requiredResult: generation fails with useful diagnostics; no skipped validation

cases.inputOrMutation: same valid source and accounts projected twice
cases.requiredResult: identical canonical design output without timestamps/random IDs

cases.inputOrMutation: successful schema/reference/accounting suite
cases.requiredResult: no dossier64, historical approval, native capability, balance or GAME VERIFIED claim

cases.inputOrMutation: two nonoverlapping work/reception zones in one hub, distinct point IDs and matching offsets
cases.requiredResult: resolve each recipe to its exact zone; no assumption that pointId equals hubId

cases.inputOrMutation: same pointId bound to two different zone IDs or same zone bound twice
cases.requiredResult: reject ambiguous point/zone mapping before resolving recipe bindings

cases.inputOrMutation: point binding claims a hub/offset different from its profile zone
cases.requiredResult: reject disagreement; profile zone remains sole geometric authority

cases.inputOrMutation: legitimate pointId but authored tile differs from hub-centre plus zone offset
cases.requiredResult: reject relocation; never derive away an existing map-point disagreement

cases.inputOrMutation: finite coordinate differences at and above0.000001tile on either axis
cases.requiredResult: allow only arithmetic tolerance<=0.000001; reject greater drift without snapping

requiredChecks: all63legacy dossiers and their rendered artifacts unchanged
independent model review and official DelendAI gate
